intro: Under 20,000 PKR you are buying a basic Android phone for calls, WhatsApp and light use. Expect 4 GB of RAM, a 5000 mAh battery and a 90Hz screen at best.

faq.q: What can I expect from a phone under 20,000 PKR?
faq.a: A basic Android phone for calls, WhatsApp, YouTube and light social media. Expect around 4 GB of RAM, a large battery and a slower chip, so heavy games and multitasking will lag.

faq.q: Should I buy a PTA approved phone at this price?
faq.a: Yes. A phone that is not PTA approved works on a Pakistani SIM only for a limited time and is then blocked unless the PTA tax is paid, which can cost more than the price gap. Every headline price on this site is for a PTA approved unit.

faq.q: What is the difference between official and shop warranty?
faq.a: Official warranty is honoured by the brand's own service centres across Pakistan. Shop warranty depends on the seller who sold you the phone and usually ends if the shop closes or refuses the claim. We mark which one each listing comes with.

faq.q: How current are these prices?
faq.a: Every price is checked by hand on official brand stores and major Pakistani retailers, rounded to the nearest 500 PKR, and shown with the date it was checked. Prices move often, so confirm with the seller before you pay.

faq.a: Often yes. The extra money usually buys 128 GB of storage instead of 64 GB and sometimes a smoother screen, which matters more over two or three years than most spec sheet differences.
